title_en: Resolution of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Approving the Interim Measures of the State Council on the Placement of Aged, Weak, Sick and Disabled Cadres

articles.content_en:
(Adopted on May 24, 1978)
The Second Session of the Standing Committee of the Fifth National People's Congress decides to approve in principle the Interim Measures of the State Council on the Placement of Old, Weak, Ill, and Disabled Cadres.
